form: Earth -> Moon (stop) -> Bennu; objective: arrive 'warm'
gaps: small-body ephemeris (Bennu); multi-leg; thermal constraint is physically meaningless for months-long TOF
why: Two legs are solvable, but 'warm' after months in space is infeasible: needs a counter-offer (heated box, or 'warm' = sunlit arrival).

form: Earth -> Mars; depart <= 2026-12-25; minimise C3
why: Fits origin/destination/window/objective dropdowns.

form: Earth -> Mars; 2026 window; minimise TOF s.t. C3 <= 15
why: One extra numeric cap field.

form: Earth -> Mars; minimise arrival v_inf; departure weekday in {Sat, Sun}
why: Calendar filter + objective; a checkbox row covers it.

form: Earth -> Jupiter; depart in 2027; minimise C3
why: Plain form; single Lambert leg.

form: Earth -> Ceres; depart in 2027; arrive < 2030; minimise C3
why: Form-shaped, but blocked offline until small-body data is available.

form: Earth -> Venus (flyby) -> Earth; return <= 2027-06-01
why: Deterministic once parsed ('her birthday' resolved by the user's date); likely infeasible -> may escalate to N.

form: Earth -> Venus (GA) -> Mars; depart 2028; sum dv <= 4 km/s
why: Fully specified but needs a 'via' list and a budget field; MGA search is deterministic.

form: Earth -> Moon -> Mars (stay) -> Earth; return <= 2028-11-23
gaps: multi-leg with stays; holiday date resolution
why: Deterministic after parsing; conjunction-class Mars stays return ~2029, so probably infeasible -> N.

form: Earth -> Europa; direct transfer only; minimise C3
why: 'Motion sick' must be mapped to 'no flybys' (irrelevant physiology); then deterministic.

form: Earth -> Phobos (stop) -> Mars; acceleration cap
gaps: satellite ephemeris (Phobos); 2 g is a launch/landing constraint, not a ballistic one
why: Parse + map the comfort cap onto launcher/lander choices; trajectory part is deterministic.

form: Earth -> SEL2 halo; min lunar distance >= X
gaps: CR3BP / halo solver (Lambert cannot do L2)
why: Deterministic constraint once 'well clear' gets a number; capability gap in the core.

form: Earth -> Saturn (flyby) -> Uranus or Neptune
why: 'Rains diamonds' is pop-science for Uranus/Neptune (ambiguous); 'scenic' must become a flyby constraint.

form: Earth -> Roadster; objective undefined ('romantic')
why: Needs a clarifying question: low arrival speed? Earthrise view? arrival on a date?

form: reference to a film's Earth-Mars mission profile; objective: lower cost
why: Must recall the film's mission (Ares/Hermes) and ask what 'cheaper' gives up.

form: Earth -> Mars surface (Jezero); arrival date = friend's landing date (unknown)
why: 'My friend's rover' and its landing date are unknown; must ask.

form: Earth -> Jupiter atmosphere entry at a storm; arrive <= next Jupiter opposition
why: Resolve 'next opposition' and the GRS location; the 'deliver into a storm' goal then needs N.

form: Earth -> Mars; TOF <= 1 day
why: Physically infeasible; a planner can prove it but must offer alternatives.

form: Earth -> Voyager 1; arrive before it leaves
why: Already past the heliopause (2012) at ~17 km/s; offer a radio message instead.
Mercury needs C3 well above 20 and months of flight; must renegotiate dates or energy.
